title.en: Simple past: I walked, I went
title.de: Simple Past: I walked, I went
title.es: Past simple: I walked, I went

status: draft: written 2026-11-27, waiting for a native speaker's check

explanation.en: Yesterday, last week, two days ago: it's finished. Regular verbs add -ed: walk → walked, play → played. The same for I, you, he, we and they.
explanation.de: Yesterday, last week, two days ago: Es ist vorbei. Regelmäßige Verben bekommen -ed: walk → walked, play → played. Das ist das Simple Past, für alle Personen gleich.
explanation.es: Yesterday, last week, two days ago: ya pasó. Los verbos regulares añaden -ed: walk → walked, play → played. Es el past simple, igual para todas las personas.

explanation.en: Some verbs change their spelling: stop → stopped (double letter), study → studied (y becomes ied), live → lived (only -d).
explanation.de: Manche Verben ändern die Schreibung: stop → stopped (Buchstabe doppelt), study → studied (y wird zu ied), live → lived (nur -d).
explanation.es: Algunos verbos cambian al escribirse: stop → stopped (letra doble), study → studied (la y pasa a ied), live → lived (solo -d).

explanation.en: Some verbs have their own past form. Learn them by heart: go → went, see → saw, have → had, eat → ate. Never 'goed'!
explanation.de: Unregelmäßige Verben haben eine eigene Vergangenheitsform. Die lernst du auswendig: go → went, see → saw, have → had, eat → ate. Nie 'goed'!
explanation.es: Los verbos irregulares tienen su propia forma de pasado. Apréndela de memoria: go → went, see → saw, have → had, eat → ate. ¡Nunca 'goed'!

explanation.es: Más verbos con su propia forma de pasado: buy → bought, make → made, come → came, take → took, write → wrote, win → won.

explanation.en: Careful with these: run → ran, swim → swam, sleep → slept, sit → sat, forget → forgot, find → found.
explanation.de: Vorsicht bei diesen: run → ran, swim → swam, sleep → slept, sit → sat, forget → forgot, find → found.
explanation.es: Cuidado con estos: run → ran, swim → swam, sleep → slept, sit → sat, forget → forgot, find → found.

explanation.en: The past of am and is is was. The past of are is were: I was, he/she/it was; you/we/they were.
explanation.de: Die Vergangenheit von am und is ist was, von are ist were: I was, he/she/it was; you/we/they were.
explanation.es: El pasado de am e is es was; el de are es were: I was, he/she/it was; you/we/they were.

explanation.en: No in the past with be: wasn't (was not) and weren't (were not). He wasn't at home. They weren't late.
explanation.de: Verneinung mit be in der Vergangenheit: wasn't (was not) und weren't (were not). He wasn't at home. They weren't late.
explanation.es: Negación de be en pasado: wasn't (was not) y weren't (were not). He wasn't at home. They weren't late.

explanation.en: Questions with be in the past: Was he …? Were you …? Short answers: Yes, I was. / No, they weren't.
explanation.de: Fragen mit be in der Vergangenheit: Was he …? Were you …? Kurzantworten: Yes, I was. / No, they weren't.
explanation.es: Preguntas con be en pasado: Was he …? Were you …? Respuestas cortas: Yes, I was. / No, they weren't.

explanation.en: No in the past: didn't + the normal verb. I didn't go, she didn't play (not 'didn't went').
explanation.de: Verneinung in der Vergangenheit: didn't + Grundform. I didn't go, she didn't play (nicht 'didn't went').
explanation.es: Negación en pasado: didn't + verbo en forma base. I didn't go, she didn't play (no 'didn't went').

explanation.en: Questions in the past: Did + person + normal verb. Did you see …? Did she go …? (not 'Did she went?'). Short answers: Yes, I did. / No, he didn't.
explanation.de: Fragen in der Vergangenheit: Did + Person + Grundform. Did you see …? Did she go …? (nicht 'Did she went?'). Kurzantworten: Yes, I did. / No, he didn't.
explanation.es: Preguntas en pasado: Did + persona + verbo en forma base. Did you see …? Did she go …? (no 'Did she went?'). Respuestas cortas: Yes, I did. / No, he didn't.

explanation.en: Time words for the past: yesterday, last night, last week, two days ago. 'ago' comes after the time: two days ago.
explanation.de: Signalwörter für die Vergangenheit: yesterday, last night, last week, two days ago. 'ago' steht hinten: two days ago (auf Deutsch 'vor zwei Tagen', aber nicht 'before two days').
explanation.es: Palabras de tiempo del pasado: yesterday, last night, last week, two days ago. 'ago' va detrás: two days ago (hace dos días).
